title: Naseeb
desc: Namdev, Raghu, Damu, and Jaggi win a lottery. Greed consumes Raghu and Damu, who murder Jaggi and frame Namdev. Returning later, Namdev seeks revenge against his betrayers.

title: Samadhi
desc: Lakhan Singh leaves crime for love and marries Champa. When she falls ill, he's forced to return to his old ways to save her.

title: Ek Rishtaa: The Bond of Love
desc: Ajay's relationship with his powerful businessman father is strained, but when he discovers his brother-in-law's malicious plans, he rises to protect his family.

title: Little John
desc: John seeks a guru's help to impress his girlfriend's parents but ends up shrinking instead of turning invisible. To reverse it, he must find a powerful magic ring.

title: Taal
desc: Mansi rises to fame with Vikrant's help after being insulted. But when her ex apologises and wants her back, she must choose between past pain and present success.

title: Koi Mil Gaya
desc: Rohit, a mentally challenged youth, befriends an alien. When police discover the creature, they try to capture it, while Rohit bravely protects his extraordinary friend against all odds.

title: Saheb Biwi Aur Gangster 3
desc: After returning from jail, Aditya seeks to reclaim his political legacy, but his encounter with London based gangster Uday sparks a fierce battle for power and survival.

title: Bamfaad
desc: Nasir, a reckless politician's son, falls for Neelam, a rival's mistress. Their affair sparks a violent feud that spirals into bloodshed and political chaos.

title: Phool Bane Angaray
desc: Ranjit Singh uncovers strong evidence against a corrupt politician, putting himself at risk, while his wife courageously joins the police force to help him fight for justice.

title: Main Tulsi Tere Aangan Ki
desc: Thakur Rajnath loves Tulsi, a former prostitute, but marries Sanjukta to please his mother. After Tulsi's death, Sanjukta faces a dilemma when she discovers Ajay's wrongdoing. What will she choose?

title: 16Th December
desc: Four Indian Revenue Service officers race against time to track and intercept Pakistani terrorists plotting a nuclear attack on New Delhi, risking everything to prevent disaster.

title: F.A.L.T.U
desc: Four underachieving friends create a fake university after failing exams, but their risky lie spirals into chaos as reality catches up with their desperate attempt to secure a future.

title: Super Singh
desc: Super Singh, a carefree man living with his mother in Canada, gains superpowers and returns to Punjab to battle drug lords and corrupt politicians threatening his homeland.

title: Article 15
desc: Senior police officer Ayaan Ranjan has to come to grips with the reality of caste discrimination in the rural heartlands of India when a gruesome and unjust rape and murder case lands on his desk.

title: Mom
desc: Devki, a biology teacher, turns to private detective DK after her stepdaughter's rapists are acquitted. Fueled by anguish, she vows revenge and sets out to deliver justice herself.

title: Socha Na Tha
desc: Viren cant imagine having an arranged marriage. His parents want him to meet Aditi. They refuse to get married but stay friends. Will Cupid strike and change their minds?
